policy: A historical frozen target does not silently migrate across architecture versions. Baseline rows are a deterministic, immutable view of the pre-V3 frozen register. New predictive custody is an append-only event committed before comparison, then anchored to its first-appearance commit. Only an anchored event on the current anchored AV-n can qualify an attained predictive observation row. A superseded void row remains void; a distinct successor must be a new event.
